title: The summary card, counts per verdict, and the section review
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with a mix of OK, Monitor and Not OK findings, and at least one verdict with no findings (seed a template with several checkbox fields and set the mix). Test both with ShopCoach enabled and with it disabled.
custom_steps:
1. Read the summary card: completion line, a count per verdict, and the findings list naming each flagged position as field, axle, row and position with its reading.
2. Confirm a verdict with no findings is not counted on the card.
3. With ShopCoach, read the footer (View PDF, Go to work order, Build lines) and the one product note above it; without ShopCoach, read the footer (View PDF, Go to work order) and the plain line about the report, note feed and work order.
4. Confirm the section-by-section review sits below the card, and that service advisor, start time and per-section progress are not shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The screen leads with a summary card: the completion line, a count per verdict, and a findings list naming each flagged position (field, axle, row, position) with the reading that earned it.
  • A verdict with no findings under it is not counted on the card.
  • With ShopCoach the card footer offers View PDF, Go to work order and Build lines with the product named once above it; without ShopCoach it offers View PDF and Go to work order plus a plain line pointing to the customer report, the work order note feed and where the lines are added.
  • The section-by-section review sits below the summary card, and the service advisor, start time and per-section progress are not shown on this screen.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9101 (S3 — Build from a completed inspection); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S3; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R4: “The screen will lead with a summary card: the completion line, a count per verdict, and a findings list naming each flagged position as field, axle, row and position with the reading that earned it”
  • S3-R5: “A verdict with no findings under it will not be counted on the card. A zero reads as a finding at a glance, which is the opposite of what it says”
  • S3-R6: “With ShopCoach the card's footer will offer View PDF, Go to work order and Build lines, and a note above it will name the product once. Without ShopCoach the footer will offer View PDF and Go to work order, and the same space will carry a plain line saying the findings are on the customer report and in the work order note feed and that the lines are added on the work order”
  • S3-R7: “The section-by-section review of what the technician entered will stay below the summary card. The card answers what happened; the sections answer what was entered. The service advisor, the inspection's start time and per-section progress are not carried onto this screen: the first two belong to the work order the inspection was run on, and progress means nothing once the inspection is locked”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
